races.name: Fructan
races.description: Colourful, flavourful fruit-born folk; charismatic and adventurous.

races.name: Vegfolk
races.description: Grounded and practical vegetable folk of the Root Realms and Leafy Canopies.

races.name: Fungifolk
races.description: Earthy, enigmatic folk bound to the mycelial networks of the Marketrealm.

races.name: Rootkin
races.description: Ancient root-folk tied to deep soil, patience and vegetable memory.

races.name: Dairyfolk
races.description: Cultured folk born of cheeses, creams and milk products.

races.name: Frostreem
races.description: Frozen dairyfolk descended from enchanted custards, gelatos and ice creams.

races.name: Sizzlarian / Meatfolk
races.description: Meat-born folk whose Emberwalk reveals their adult path and True Flame Name.

races.name: Herbanite / Herbfolk
races.description: Fragrant plantfolk born of aromatic roots and leaves.

races.name: The Recalled
races.description: Removed, discontinued or spoiled foodstuffs returned with strange memories and patchwork forms.

races.name: Boxfolk
races.description: Awakened preserved, canned and frozen goods with durable shells and perfect memories.

races.name: Sweetfolk
races.description: Confection-born folk united by sugarblood and distracting sweetness.

races.name: Marshmallow Folk
races.description: Puffy folk of the Cereal Steppes, sweet, buoyant and unexpectedly flame-touched.

races.name: Fluffling
races.description: Airy beings woven from enchanted sugar threads, cheerful and difficult to pin down.

races.name: Drinkling
races.description: Fluid folk bound to flow, refreshment and change.
